newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka stocks end firmer led by blue chips.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka stocks end firmer led by blue chips.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks closed slightly higher on Tuesday boosted by investor buying of blue chips in the financial sector, brokers said.
The all share index closed 1.8 points up at 599.27. Development Finance Corp rose one rupee to 273 rupees, Hatton National Bank gained 9.75 to 225 and Lanka Orix Leasing up five to 130.
"One reason for the rise is the lack of sellers," said Prasanna Chandrasekera of brokerage John Keells.
"The index is waiting for a direction and whether it comes from the budget or corporate results, is left to be seen," said Ruan Dayananda of Asia Securities.

Turnover was 34.1 million rupees on 1.5 million shares. Some 500,000 Sampath Bank shares changed hands at 46 rupees, unchanged on the day before, while 500,000 shares of Distilleries Co were sold at its previous price of 6.50.
Foreign buying was 2.2 million rupees and selling, 26.28 million.
